plain: To go against or oppose a law, rule, or act.

webster.text: Literally, to come against; to meet.

example.quote: If it does not supersede their existing laws, as far as they contravene its operation, it cannot be of any effect.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
